faq.question: What happens after I submit the form?
faq.answer: We review the context you shared, loop in the right engineer, and reply with a short agenda plus two time options.

faq.question: Can you sign an NDA before sharing details?
faq.answer: Yes. Mention it in your note and we will countersign your standard NDA or provide ours.

faq.question: Do you work with agencies or systems integrators?
faq.answer: Absolutely—we partner with SI and BPO teams building supervised AI practices for their clients.
